values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included; DEC's 2026 summary sets a 1-night reservation minimum here. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register by 9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

note: DEC (Adirondacks, Inlet). Lakeside trailer sites; guarded beach, boat launch, canoe rentals. Bear-proof food lockers are provided. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20 + $5 non-resident (DEC 2026 summary), phone 315-357-4401, no electric (now verified from the RA site list), ReserveAmerica 9-month window, 14-night max, max rig 40 ft, 2027 opening May 14. Season left as is (its manual note stands); for a human: DEC's 2026 summary closes Limekiln Lake Sept 7 (last night the night before) and ReserveAmerica's 2027 season ends Sun Sep 5, so a closes of 09-05 is supportable, as at Caroga Lake 1410. Sites 271 -> 270 (DEC summary). Added showers, flush toilets, dump, spigots. Note trimmed of count/hookups/length/booking; bear-locker line added. Not stated: water/sewer at sites (left as derived).
